race.comment: PUREZZA (3) loves it here on her home circuit with four wins and ten placings from 20 spins. Gets some weight relief with the 2kg claim and looms as the main danger. LOVE TO BE PROUD (9) was a touch disappointing last time out but the form prior was full of merit. Worth another chance. INVISIBLE TARGET (13) next in line from the favourable draw. SHE'S BRUTAL (11) has been knocking on the door and could easily put it all together today.
